facts.business: Euro Pratik Sales Limited is one of India's leading decorative wall panel brands, offering wall panels, louvers, chisel panels, Auris panels, and decorative laminates for homes, offices, hotels, and commercial spaces.

auditor.name: M/s. M Baldeva Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, observations, adverse remarks or disclaimers by the Statutory Auditors. Secretarial Auditors noted short notice to stock exchanges for record date and delay in filing some e-forms with ROC, both described as inadvertent.

key_risks: Liquidity risk perceived as low due to sufficient cash, borrowing lines, and operating cash flows
Credit risk on trade receivables with expected credit loss allowance of Rs 225 lakh as at March 31, 2026
Regulatory compliance risk evidenced by fines paid to NSE and BSE for short notice of record date
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables include amounts due from firms or private companies in which any director is a partner, director or member (refer note 40). No trade receivables are due from directors or other officers of the Company.
